<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Mastermind</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
#pal{position:fixed;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:0 8px}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0f172aee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;width:min(90vw,340px)}
button{background:#38bdf8;color:#04202e;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700}button:disabled{background:#26334d;color:#7a8aa8}
</style><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="pal"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=20,K='mg_mastermind',T='🧠 Mastermind',hint='Đoán dãy màu ẩn: chọn màu (chạm/click hoặc phím số), ⌫ để xoá, ✔ (Enter) để gửi. ⚫ = đúng màu đúng chỗ, ⚪ = đúng màu sai chỗ. Màu có thể lặp lại';
let W,H,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw">${hint}</p>`;for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);g.append(b)}}
function end(w,t){if(!run)return;draw();run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:t||'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){lt=t;if(run)draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
const CL=['#ef4444','#22c55e','#3b82f6','#eab308','#a855f7','#f97316','#e5e7eb','#a16207'],EM=['🔴','🟢','🔵','🟡','🟣','🟠','⚪','🟤'];
let cl,nc,tries,S,rows,gs;
function init(){cl=3+(lv>6)+(lv>13);nc=Math.min(4+((lv-1)>>2),8);tries=lv<=13?10:12;S=Array.from({length:cl},()=>Math.random()*nc|0);rows=[];gs=[];pal.innerHTML='';
for(let i=0;i<nc;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.style.cssText=`background:${CL[i]};color:#000;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;padding:0`;b.textContent=i+1;b.onclick=()=>add(i);pal.append(b)}
[['⌫',del],['✔',sub]].forEach(([t,f])=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=t;b.style.cssText='width:56px;height:44px';b.onclick=f;pal.append(b)})}
function add(i){if(run&&gs.length<cl)gs.push(i)}function del(){if(run)gs.pop()}
function sub(){if(!run||gs.length<cl)return;let b=0,w=0;const a=[],t=[];gs.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v==S[i])b++;else{a.push(v);t.push(S[i])}});a.forEach(v=>{const j=t.indexOf(v);if(j>=0){w++;t.splice(j,1)}});rows.push({g:gs,b,w});gs=[];if(b==cl)end(1);else if(rows.length>=tries)end(0,'💥 Hết lượt! Mã là '+S.map(i=>EM[i]).join(' '))}
function upd(){}
function draw(){C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const rh=Math.min((H-170)/tries,48),x0=(W-(cl+1.8)*rh)/2,y0=40;
for(let i=0;i<tries;i++){const y=y0+i*rh+rh/2,R=i<rows.length?rows[i]:i==rows.length?{g:gs}:null;
for(let j=0;j<cl;j++){const v=R&&R.g[j]!=null?R.g[j]:-1;C.beginPath();C.arc(x0+j*rh+rh/2,y,rh*.36,0,7);if(v>=0){C.fillStyle=CL[v];C.fill()}else{C.strokeStyle=i==rows.length?'#94a3b8':'#334155';C.lineWidth=2;C.stroke()}}
if(R&&R.b!=null)for(let k=0;k<cl;k++){const bx=x0+cl*rh+rh*.3+(k%3)*rh*.4,by=y-rh*.2+(k/3|0)*rh*.4;C.beginPath();C.arc(bx,by,rh*.12,0,7);if(k<R.b+R.w){C.fillStyle=k<R.b?'#000':'#fff';C.fill();C.strokeStyle='#fff';C.lineWidth=1.5}else{C.strokeStyle='#334155';C.lineWidth=1.5}C.stroke()}}
h.textContent=`Màn ${lv} · Lượt ${Math.min(rows.length+1,tries)}/${tries} · ⚫ đúng chỗ, ⚪ sai chỗ`}
onkeydown=e=>{const k=e.key;if(k>='1'&&k<='8'&&+k<=nc)add(+k-1);else if(k=='Backspace')del();else if(k=='Enter')sub()};
menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
